from: July book, night 23 (The Eyes of the Lord)
p1: Many years later, another king made trouble for King Asa. This time, Asa did not ask the Lord for help.
Instead, he sent silver and gold to the king of Syria for help.
Then Hanani, a prophet who saw what others could not, came to Asa. He said, “You leaned on the king of Syria, not on the Lord.”
p2: Hanani said, “When you trusted the Lord before, He helped you.” He also said, “The eyes of the Lord run all over the earth.” The Lord sees everyone and helps those whose whole heart is His. The Lord is Jesus.
Jesus sees you right now, snug in your bed. Tonight, give Him your whole heart. You can trust Him first.
old: King Asa had trusted God for many years. But when a new problem came, Asa forgot to ask Heavenly Father first. Instead, he tried to fix it all by himself. He made a deal with another king for help.
A wise messenger named Hanani came to Asa. He said, “Asa, why didn’t you trust the Lord this time? God’s eyes look all over the earth to help those who trust Him.”
Asa felt upset because he knew he had made a mistake. Even good King Asa forgot to lean on God this time. We all make mistakes sometimes. The important thing is to remember to trust God again.
Heavenly Father wants us to trust Him in EVERYTHING — big and small. Even when we forget, we can turn back to Him. God is always watching, ready to help. Let’s remember to ask Him first.
